acceptance: _format_query_tag(query_id) used symmetrically in execute path (ALTER SESSION) and get_query_execution_stats (QUERY_HISTORY lookup); native runs keep exact legacy tag
Unit test proves stats retrieval works under a gateway tag; legacy native tag behavior unchanged
Run-level suffix scheme documented for vendor log-join
context: Delivered in merged PR #3450: SnowflakeAdapter._format_query_tag(query_id) is used by execute_query (ALTER SESSION SET QUERY_TAG) and _get_query_statistics (QUERY_HISTORY lookup) — the item's method names execute_query_with_retry/get_query_execution_stats do not exist in the code. Native runs keep the legacy tag `<query_tag>_<query_id>`; gateway runs append `_gw-<8 hex>` generated once per adapter instance (not a config option, so no user text reaches the SQL). Five mocked-connection tests (native unchanged, stable within a run, differs between runs, execute and stats use the same tag, stats retrieved under a gateway tag); docs/platforms/snowflake.md documents the scheme. No live Snowflake/gateway run.
description: Add SnowflakeAdapter._format_query_tag(query_id) used in BOTH execute_query_with_retry and get_query_execution_stats so gateway run suffixes stay consistent; native tag format unchanged; unit test for gateway-tag stats retrieval.
